metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded using EPOC X hardware with bandpass filtering applied during acquisition. Each participant completed a combined session consisting of eyes-open baseline (~20 s, participant-controlled duration), eyes-closed baseline (~20 s, participant-controlled duration), and sequential exposures to two soundscape conditions (jungle and deconstruct, ~17 s each). Liking ratings and baseline state survey items were collected per participant. Recording timestamps were removed and participant IDs were de-identified sequentially.
